title: Maali: private personal finance for Mac and Windows
excerpt: A complete personal-finance app with an AI analyst, and everything runs on your own computer. It works with the Wi-Fi off, because your data never needs to leave.
content_html:
Works with the Wi-Fi off

Your money, your machine.

Drop in your bank’s statement files, or connect once through SimpleFIN. Maali sorts every charge and tells you how your month is going. Everything, even the AI analyst, runs on your own computer.

The full app, free for 30 days. No account. No card. Then $99 once. Every update included.

Try the live demo → Explore with made-up data.

How it works

From your bank to a clear answer.

    • CSV files
    • SimpleFIN

    1Bring in your bank data

    Drop in the CSV files your bank already offers. Or connect once through SimpleFIN and new charges arrive on their own.

  2. 2Every charge sorted

    Change one and Maali remembers it for that merchant.

  3. 3See where you stand

    What changed, what looks unusual, and whether you’re on track.

The unplug test

Pull the network cable. Maali doesn’t notice.

The app, your numbers and the AI analyst all live on your computer. Bank data comes in one of two ways, and Maali never sees your bank sign-ins. SimpleFIN is an independent read-only service, and your bank sign-ins stay on its own site.
